verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no CoreWeave feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The Terraform provider (coreweave-docs-6) lets users manage infrastructure as code, but versioning, review, and rollback would come from the user's own source control and Terraform workflow. That is a building block and user-side workaround, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
